baselines.name: ordinary-native-end-to-end
constraints: Same CLI/version/model/effort, initial task/materials and automatic-memory policy
One continuous independent native session per arm; preserve ordinary history
Capture and report every observed attempt, including compaction, retry, warmup and unfinished work
Keep initial setup in whole-session total; report predeclared late segment separately

baselines.name: matched-mode-diagnostic
baselines.purpose: Isolate runtime mode, not replace ordinary baseline
constraints: For Kimi, independently validate native ACP control and official approval semantics
Keep modes and permission policy explicit; never weaken Loom execution fences
Report per-request tools/settings/system/history differences; session cache keys may legitimately differ

beforePaidLaunch: Freeze exact source/fixture/model binding and requested budgets using existing authorized gate rules
Free-test final runner, isolation, automatic-memory policy, complete request/response capture, usage deduplication, failure ledger and cleanup
Freeze independent trajectory count and arm order/counterbalancing; do not select from completed outcomes
analysis: Report each CLI/model separately and retain failures; do not pool providers into one claimed ratio
Use complete independent session pairs as replication units; twelve dependent turns are not twelve independent samples
Report ratio of summed paired consumption alongside pair-level variation, outputs and business quality
Keep all-input, cached/uncached where provided, reasoning/output and all-attempt/request counts separate; missing remains unknown
Token totals do not establish monetary cost; use actual applicable billing evidence before making price claims
Request bytes/history hashes locate mechanisms but are not token estimates or proof of causality
Do not truncate reasoning/history or remove failed steps from totals to manufacture parity
